canon: Fauna de 120-180 cm, tipo gacela, con cuernos finos y largos de cabra montesa (sin apenas espiral), cuello ancho y pelaje muy corto, rojo por arriba y blanco por el vientre. Come pasto y hojas altas gracias al cuello largo. Vive en manada. Las hembras llevan más rojo que los machos y cuernos más anchos.

prompt.sujeto: A tall, slender herd grazer with an upright neck and long, thin legs.
prompt.proporcion: Its neck is as long as its legs: from the shoulder to the top of the head it measures the same as from the shoulder to the ground, so the head is held about three and a half metres above the earth.
prompt.ancla: the small head of a deer on the upright neck of a giraffe
prompt.cuerpo: Its head is small, with large dark eyes and a short tuft of beard. The very short coat is rust red along the back and neck and creamy white on the belly, throat and inner legs.
rasgos: Two wide, flat horns shaped like broad leaf blades, pale bone grey and veined like real leaves, stick out straight sideways from the top of its head.
Each long leg ends in a large splayed foot of three clawed toes, like a big bird's.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Its long neck is thick at the base and tapers toward the head.
prompt.pose: Seen in three-quarter view from a low camera angle, it is caught mid-step with its weight on the far hind leg and its small head turned toward the viewer, filling three quarters of the image height.
prompt.manada: Around it graze and wander five more grazers at different distances, each one a tall slender animal with a long upright neck, a small head and two flat pale leaf-blade horns sticking out sideways, smaller and softer with distance.
prompt.entorno: The land is red desert earth with dry scrub and tufts of pale grass, and red sandstone mesas and spires stand on the horizon.
prompt.luz: Clear daylight under a blue sky with scattered white clouds, with high light from the left so the long neck and the horns cast crisp shadows on the ground.

rasgos+: This male has the larger, wider-spreading leaf horns of the herd.
This female has a deeper red coat and shorter, broader leaf horns.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
choca con el canon: cuernos de hoja (el canon: finos y largos de cabra montesa), pies de ave de tres dedos, cuello de jirafa
IMG-16 (perfil fotorreal): cuello de 3,5 m de alto (el canon: 120-180 cm de animal) y cabeza «de ciervo sobre cuello de jirafa»; diseño de imagen, no canon

momento:noche.luz: Under a starry night sky with a soft, even pearly glow, a cool silver light falls evenly from above, so the long neck and the horns cast faint, soft shadows on the dark ground.

capas.corto: A single tall male herd grazer, full body in three-quarter view, centre of the frame, head turned to the viewer. Clear bright daylight from the left. Two wide, flat horns shaped like broad leaf blades, pale bone grey and veined like real leaves, stick out straight sideways from the top of its head. It has the small head of a deer on the upright neck of a giraffe, as long as its legs, and long thin legs ending in big splayed three-toed feet like a bird's. Very short rust-red coat, cream white underneath and on the front of the neck. Five more graze behind it. Red desert earth, dry scrub, red mesas.
capas.sujeto: A single tall male herd grazer with an upright neck, seen in full body from three-quarters at a low camera angle, standing in the centre of the image with its small head turned to the viewer, filling three quarters of the image height.
capas.luz: Clear bright daylight from high on the left: the red back and neck and the leaf horns are well lit, the cream underside and the far-side legs stay in soft shadow, and the animal casts a crisp shadow on the ground.
capas.tamano: From the shoulder to the top of the head it measures the same as from the shoulder to the ground, so the head is held higher than a giraffe's, about three and a half metres up; the horns spread wider than its shoulders; it is far taller than the scrub around its feet.
capas.forma: A tall, slender body like a gazelle's on very long thin legs, each ending in a large splayed foot of three clawed toes like a big bird's. A long upright neck, thick at the base and tapering toward the head, as long as the legs. A small head like a deer's, with large dark eyes and a short tuft of beard. Two wide, flat, leaf-shaped horns, like broad willow leaves with a pointed tip and a central vein, sticking out straight sideways in a line from the top of the head, each as long as the head is.
capas.entorno: In the foreground, red desert earth with dry scrub, tufts of pale grass and a few red rocks. In the middle distance, open dry steppe with the herd. On the horizon, flat-topped red sandstone mesas and a rock tower, under a blue sky with scattered white clouds.
capas.color: Very short rust-red coat along the back and neck, dusty at the legs; cream white underneath, the front of the neck and the inner legs; pale bone-grey leaf horns with darker veins; grey feet; red clay earth; straw-coloured grass; dark green scrub.
capas.repetir: Around it graze and wander five more of the same animals at different distances, each tall and slender with a long upright neck, a small head and two flat pale leaf-blade horns, smaller and softer with distance.
capas.paleta: rust red, cream white and straw yellow with one accent of pale blue sky
capas.notas: IMG-55, escrita mirando el banner. Macho. Diferencias con el canon: cuernos de hoja anchos y planos que salen rectos hacia los lados (el canon: finos, largos y casi rectos como de cabra montesa); cuello larguísimo, tan largo como las patas, 'de jirafa' (el canon: cuello ancho, animal de 120-180 cm); patas finas con pies de ave de tres dedos (el canon no dice patas); barbita corta; cuerpo y cuello rojos, blanco en vientre y delante del cuello; manada de cinco; mesas de arenisca roja y torre rocosa al fondo, matorral seco. Coincide con prompt r14 (12/10 de la usuaria).
